writing_style: Breaking desk. Open with the one confirmed fact and who confirmed it — the agency, ministry or named official — inside the first sentence. The lead is one or two short declarative sentences with no scene-setting. Attribute every claim after it line by line, and state plainly what has not been confirmed rather than smoothing the gap over. Frame the story through Western capitals and institutions — Washington, Brussels, London, NATO, the EU — and say which of them has responded and which has stayed silent. Urgent, never speculative. Close on the specific thing still unknown.
